threat_event: Business email compromise redirects an owner progress payment to an attacker-controlled account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 300 pay apps a month averaging $1.33 million; owners rely on email for remittance details; lookalike domains are cheap; project managers on push MFA
affected_asset_or_process: BP-02 owner billing; SYS-05 mailboxes; owner relationships
regulatory_driver: FAR 52.232-33(b); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05; Fla. Stat. 501.171
existing_controls: DMARC at reject; lookalike domain monitoring; pay app cover sheet warning; inbox-rule alerts (enterprise tenant); call-back advice letters to owners
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for project managers (POAM-017); role-based payment fraud training (POAM-011); materiality playbook payment scenario (POAM-009); annual remittance confirmation letters to every owner
key_risk_indicator: Owner remittance inquiries; lookalike domains detected; project manager phishing-resistant MFA coverage

threat_event: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing steals a project manager's session and bypasses push MFA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2,900 project management staff on number-matching push; session tokens usable from unmanaged devices for SYS-01 and email
existing_controls: Number-matching push; token binding for ERP and payment hub; risky sign-in alerts
treatment_plan: FIDO2 keys or device-bound passkeys for all project management staff (POAM-017); token binding extended to email and SYS-01
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management
key_risk_indicator: Adversary-in-the-middle sign-ins detected; phishing-resistant coverage by role

threat_event: A fraudulent subcontractor or supplier bank change is processed and a payment is sent to the attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-1 AP changes payees in the AQ-1 ERP without Payment Operations review and its files enter the payment hub; 4 of 60 enterprise changes lacked recorded call-backs (EV-2026-04 loss)
existing_controls: Payment Operations call-back and validation service for enterprise payees; interim manual review of AQ-1 new payees since 2026-05
treatment_plan: Route all AQ-1 payee changes through Payment Operations; structured call-back record; block hub files with unverified payees (POAM-003)
key_risk_indicator: Bank changes without call-back record; AQ-1 payees released without verification

threat_event: An insider creates a fictitious vendor and pays it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 enterprise users kept emergency vendor-master rights; AQ-1 AP can create and pay vendors
existing_controls: Segregation of duties rules; quarterly access certification; payee identity proofing
treatment_plan: Remove conflicting rights; AQ-1 AP moved under enterprise SoD (POAM-002)
key_risk_indicator: SoD conflicts open; new vendors paid within 7 days of creation

threat_event: Attacker changes the company's EFT details in SAM so a federal payment is diverted
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAM holds the EFT record for about $88 million a month of federal receipts; liability shifts to the company under FAR 52.232-33(e)(2)
affected_asset_or_process: SAM Entity Administrator account; BP-02 federal
existing_controls: SAM Entity Administrator on a security key since 2026-02; SAM change emails go to a monitored mailbox
treatment_plan: Monthly reconciliation of SAM EFT details to bank records; second administrator designated

threat_event: Payment files are altered between the ERP and a bank
threat_source: Cybercriminal group or insider with gateway access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files to bank 3 are not signed or hash-checked end to end
existing_controls: SFTP encryption; positive pay; gateway access through PAM
treatment_plan: Signed files or hash verification for bank 3 (POAM-006)

threat_event: Attackers register lookalike domains to impersonate the company to owners and subcontractors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many brands and project domains; owners and subcontractors cannot tell lookalikes apart
affected_asset_or_process: Company brand; owner and subcontractor relationships
existing_controls: Lookalike monitoring and takedown service; DMARC reject
treatment_plan: Defensive registration of top variants; takedown SLA 48 h
key_risk_indicator: Lookalike domains detected and time to takedown

threat_event: A subcontractor's own mailbox is compromised and sends fraudulent invoices or bank changes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7,500 payees with uneven email security
existing_controls: Call-back to a known number for every bank change; validation service
treatment_plan: Structured call-back evidence and second review (POAM-003); subcontractor fraud awareness bulletin each quarter

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the ERP, integration platform, and file systems across regions during the pay app window
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large attack surface (11,000 laptops, 140 jobsite networks); AQ-1 legacy VPN and directory; construction is a frequent ransomware target
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; SYS-07; SYS-08; BP-01 to BP-06
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on about 97% of endpoints; PAM; immutable backups; annual tier-1 DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Close AQ-1 network and monitoring gaps (POAM-016; POAM-004); SYS-01 export restore (POAM-008); enterprise ransomware tabletop with the disclosure committee (POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; DR test results

threat_event: The project management platform is down or compromised and field teams lose drawings and RFIs for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS platform for all projects; vendor RTO 24 h against a BIA RTO of 8 h; company export never restored
existing_controls: Offline tablet sync; printed sets; vendor SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Restorable read-only export; renegotiate contract RTO to 8 h (POAM-008)
owner: Vice President, Project Controls and Systems

threat_event: Cellular outage cuts jobsite trailers off from SaaS systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 40% of trailers have one carrier
existing_controls: Offline sync; second carrier at 60% of trailers
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Network Engineering with GRC concurrence; second carrier added at refresh

threat_event: A Cloud provider A region outage takes down the ERP and payment hub
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Primary region dependency; warm standby takes hours to promote
existing_controls: Warm standby region; tested 2026-05-09 (19 h)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CIO with the CFO; standby promotion runbook rehearsed yearly

threat_event: Virtual desktop outage stops BIM coordination and estimating before deadlines
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Desktops depend on one GPU pool per region
existing_controls: Images rebuilt in 4 h; laptops for estimators
treatment_plan: Second GPU pool in the standby region

threat_event: Payroll SaaS outage on craft payroll day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single payroll vendor; weekly craft payroll
existing_controls: Repeat-prior-payroll procedure; vendor test observed 2026-02
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Chief Human Resources Officer; procedure drilled yearly

threat_event: Attacker deletes or encrypts backups before triggering ransomware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup administrators are a high-value target
existing_controls: Write-once locks; separate accounts; weekly offline copy
treatment_plan: Quarterly lock verification and break-glass review

threat_event: Telecom outage at HQ-1 disrupts the SOC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC concentrated at HQ-1
existing_controls: Managed security service provider overflow; remote SOC work
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Security Operations with GRC concurrence

threat_event: A zero-day in the AQ-1 legacy VPN appliance is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-1 sites still on a legacy VPN that reaches the integration platform
existing_controls: Vendor patches applied within 72 h for exploited flaws
treatment_plan: Retire the legacy VPN with SD-WAN migration and restrict reachable subnets (POAM-016)

threat_event: CUI is uploaded to the commercial project management platform, which is not approved for CUI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CUI marking detection; federal projects share the same platform; designers send drawings the way they do on commercial jobs
existing_controls: CUI handling procedure; training for Federal Group staff
treatment_plan: Purge and attest; upload scanning for CUI markings; route designers to the FPCE exchange gateway; notify contracting officers as counsel advises (POAM-019)
key_risk_indicator: CUI marking detections on SYS-01; time to purge

threat_event: The FPCE fails its C3PAO assessment because requirements that cannot go on a POA&M are not met
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 8 requirements drifted; 3.10.3, 3.10.4, 3.12.4, and 3.1.20 cannot be on a CMMC POA&M; 3.4.1 and 3.8.1 carry more than 1 point
existing_controls: Final Level 2 (Self) since 2026-02-27; CMMC Program Office; quarterly internal checks
treatment_plan: Remediate all 8 items, update the FPCE SSP, internal mock assessment 2026-12-15 (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Requirements not met; mock assessment score

threat_event: An annual affirmation or SPRS entry overstates compliance and creates False Claims Act exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drift since the 2026-02-27 status date; DFARS 252.204-7021 defines current status as no changes in compliance
existing_controls: Counsel reviews every affirmation; evidence binder
treatment_plan: Remediate and post an updated self-assessment before relying on the status for a new award (POAM-020; POAM-024)
key_risk_indicator: Open drift items at affirmation date

threat_event: Printed CUI drawings in a plan room are viewed or taken by an unescorted visitor
threat_source: Unescorted visitors or trades (accidental or adversarial)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan rooms in trailers; visitor logs missing at 4 of 6 sampled sites; drawing sets not checked out
existing_controls: Locked cabinets; installation access control
treatment_plan: Badge-controlled plan room doors, visitor logs, check-out logs, CUI banners on plots (POAM-020)

threat_event: A subcontractor without the required CMMC status receives CUI or FCI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 640 subcontractors handle FCI and 48 handle CUI; status checked for only 19 of the 48
existing_controls: Flowdown clauses in federal subcontract template
treatment_plan: SPRS and CMMC status check before award and annually; exchange gateway access only after check (POAM-021)

threat_event: A cyber incident affecting CUI is not reported to DoD within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: BEC and SaaS incidents may not be recognized as touching CUI; SYS-01 held CUI
existing_controls: Medium assurance certificate held; CUI check step in every runbook
treatment_plan: DIBNet reporting drill in the 2026-11-19 tabletop (POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: Time from discovery to CUI determination

threat_event: BTS installs covered video surveillance or telecommunications equipment on a federal building
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Private-label products hide the original manufacturer; AQ-1 stock not screened
existing_controls: Approved manufacturer list; submittal screening
treatment_plan: OEM confirmation for private-label items; screen AQ-1 stock (POAM-022)

threat_event: FCI held on AQ-2 legacy systems is not protected to enterprise standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-2 has its own Level 1 status but legacy file server and email
existing_controls: AQ-2 Level 1 self-assessment 2025-12-12
treatment_plan: Migrate AQ-2 into the enterprise FCI scope (POAM-023)

threat_event: A Kaspersky or FASCSA covered article is found in the IT estate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large software estate; acquisitions bring unknown software
existing_controls: Software inventory checks against prohibited lists monthly
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Third-Party Risk Management with GRC concurrence

threat_event: FCI drawings in commercial-site trailers are exposed because visitors are not controlled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Federal civilian jobsites not on installations; visitor logs inconsistent
existing_controls: Locked trailers after hours
treatment_plan: Visitor sign-in and escort at federal civilian trailers before the 2027-01-30 Level 1 affirmation (POAM-024)

threat_event: Employee PII (Social Security numbers in certified payrolls) is stolen from payroll or mailboxes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Certified payrolls attached to pay apps and emailed to owners
existing_controls: Payroll role restrictions; DLP for SSNs in outbound email
treatment_plan: Truncate SSNs on certified payroll attachments where the contracting officer allows; route through owner portals

threat_event: Bid and pricing data is stolen before bid day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Estimating data shared with many subcontractors and the AI tool
existing_controls: Role-restricted estimating database; download alerts
treatment_plan: Bid-room access review before major bids

threat_event: Client facility security details (camera layouts, credentials) leak from BTS

affected_asset_or_process: SYS-11 credential vault; BTS project files
existing_controls: Dedicated vault; per-client access approval
treatment_plan: Rotate credentials after each technician change; quarterly vault access review

threat_event: External SYS-01 users see other subcontractors' pricing or other projects
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Permission templates copied between projects; stale external accounts
existing_controls: Project permission templates
treatment_plan: Closeout removal and template review (POAM-001)
owner: Vice President, Project Controls and Systems

threat_event: A lost or stolen jobsite tablet exposes drawings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 580 tablets not enrolled in device management
existing_controls: Most tablets enrolled with remote wipe
treatment_plan: Enroll remaining tablets (POAM-013)

threat_event: Staff paste FCI, bid data, or personal information into unapproved generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Free tools are easy to reach from phones and tablets
existing_controls: Approved AI tools list; web filtering
treatment_plan: Unapproved generative AI domains blocked on managed devices; enterprise assistant provided

threat_event: An employee downloads project and cost data before joining a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-01 download events not in the SIEM
existing_controls: Exit interviews; DLP on email
treatment_plan: Stream SYS-01 audit events to the SIEM (POAM-018)
owner: Vice President, Project Controls and Systems

threat_event: The project management platform vendor is breached and drawings for many projects are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds data for all projects
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; contract breach notice terms
treatment_plan: Annual vendor review; breach notice within 72 h in the renewal

threat_event: The e-signature and lien waiver service is compromised and documents are altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC report reviewed
existing_controls: Service audit trails
treatment_plan: Obtain and review SOC reports (POAM-012)

threat_event: The bank account validation service fails or returns a false match
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC report reviewed; no fallback beyond call-back
existing_controls: Call-back always required in addition
treatment_plan: Obtain SOC report; document fallback (POAM-012)

threat_event: The managed security service provider used for overflow is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Provider has read access to the SIEM
existing_controls: Read-only access; provider SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CISO with the CIO

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in an update to an ERP add-on or construction software
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many niche construction software vendors with small security teams
existing_controls: Staged rollout for ERP updates; EDR
treatment_plan: Staged rollout extended to estimating and field apps

threat_event: A compromised subcontractor account is used to plant malicious files in SYS-01
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 41,000 external users
existing_controls: Vendor malware scanning; EDR on company devices
treatment_plan: External user MFA enforced (done 2026-04); file scanning reports reviewed monthly
owner: Vice President, Project Controls and Systems

threat_event: Dependence on one project management platform makes exit or price changes hard
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All projects on one platform
existing_controls: Nightly export; multi-year contract
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO with the CIO; reviewed at renewal

threat_event: An attacker in AQ-1 moves laterally into enterprise systems through the legacy directory and VPN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-1 legacy directory and VPN reaching the integration platform
existing_controls: Firewall rules on the VPN; EDR at AQ-1
treatment_plan: Restrict VPN to named hosts; SD-WAN migration; identity federation (POAM-016; POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: AQ-1 sites on SD-WAN; AQ-1 identities federated

threat_event: AQ-1 leavers keep access because terminations are manual
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-1 legacy directory; manual HR feed
affected_asset_or_process: AQ-1 accounts with SYS-01 and ERP access
existing_controls: Daily HR report reconciliation since 2026-05
treatment_plan: Federate AQ-1 identities (POAM-014)

threat_event: An AQ-1 mailbox is compromised and nobody notices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-1 email tenant has no SIEM feed or inbox-rule alerts
existing_controls: Tenant built-in alerts reviewed by AQ-1 IT weekly
treatment_plan: Migrate to the enterprise tenant; interim SIEM connector (POAM-004)

threat_event: A future acquisition closes without security due diligence and imports new gaps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two recent acquisitions brought payment and identity gaps
existing_controls: POL-01 4.10 due diligence rule
treatment_plan: Day-one payment control checklist added to the integration playbook
key_risk_indicator: Deals with completed security due diligence

threat_event: An attacker uses BTS remote access to disable a client's access control or cameras
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote access to about 420 client buildings; technicians share vendor tools
existing_controls: Remote access gateway with per-client approval and session recording; MFA
treatment_plan: Retire vendor-specific remote tools; just-in-time access per client (SL-1 readiness, P09)

threat_event: Client system credentials are stolen from the BTS vault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High-value vault; rotation uneven
existing_controls: Vault with MFA and PAM
treatment_plan: Automated rotation for supported systems

threat_event: A building automation misconfiguration during commissioning causes a safety event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commissioning under schedule pressure
existing_controls: Commissioning checklists; client sign-off
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Vice President, Building Technology Services with GRC concurrence

threat_event: Badging and gate access outage delays work at installation jobsites

existing_controls: Printed badge lists
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO with GRC concurrence

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large volumes of cameras, controllers, and switches per building
existing_controls: Turnover checklist
treatment_plan: Automated credential check in the turnover tool
key_risk_indicator: Devices with default credentials at turnover

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process misses payment fraud or related occurrences
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook has no payment fraud scenario and no guidance on related occurrences; disclosure committee not exercised on BEC
existing_controls: Disclosure committee; outside securities counsel; EV-2026-04 reviewed
treatment_plan: Payment fraud scenario and related-occurrence rule; tabletop 2026-11-19 (POAM-009)
key_risk_indicator: Days from incident to materiality determination

threat_event: A SOX IT general control deficiency in ERP access or change management
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SoD conflicts and unapproved emergency changes found in 2026
existing_controls: Quarterly certification; CAB

treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests Item 106 statements each year

threat_event: A certified payroll record is altered before submission
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual edits in payroll exports
existing_controls: Payroll audit trail; supervisor review
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Chief Human Resources Officer with GRC concurrence

existing_controls: Feature disabled by the committee (2026-08); counsel review

existing_controls: Feature use limited to coaching

existing_controls: Approved tools list; FCI uploads to AI-001 blocked until terms signed
treatment_plan: Technical block on federal project folders; enclave-only AI review for CUI (none approved)

threat_event: AI use cases run without committee review

existing_controls: Intake rule since 2025

existing_controls: Console reachable only from the management subnet

threat_event: Equipment with telematics units is stolen from a yard
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Yards fenced but large
existing_controls: Cameras and patrols
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Vice President, Equipment and Prefabrication with GRC concurrence

threat_event: An administrator sabotages ERP master data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged ERP access
existing_controls: PAM sessions recorded; backups
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of privileged session alerts

vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Florida headquarters and colocation
existing_controls: COLO-2 in Texas; cloud standby regions; hurricane plan
